scope: Native min_2 first-operand tie behavior using the existing bounded ordering profile; not general Erlang term ordering.
adaptations: Use the same charged ordering helper as max/2 and select the second operand only when the first is strictly greater. Retain the first operand's integer/float representation on arithmetic equality.

Positively link min/2 into the complete nonallocating native BIF groups. Unsupported ordering is an explicit runtime-profile refusal, never guest notsup or false guard. Scratch OOM, accounted denial and work exhaustion remain distinct.

The shared extrema harness tests actual compiled min/max entrypoints, independent OTP integer/atom/rank answers, mixed numeric ties, body/guard profile refusal, exact work prefixes, scratch failure and final balance. Real-worker min fixtures additionally cover exact bytes, exact/one-below budgets, private reuse, peer survival and reclamation.
